season.name: Summer
season.line: Labor without Sabbath becomes bondage, however fruitful it looks.

movement.name: The Rest
movement.line: A people who cannot stop are not free.

days.t: A Sabbath rest for the people of God
x: So then, there remains a Sabbath rest for the people of God.
For the one having entered into His rest, he also rested from his works, just as God [did] from His own.

days.t: Today, if you hear his voice
x: For he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand.
To-day, if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, according to the day of irritation in the wilderness:

days.t: I myself will go before you and give you rest
x: And he says, I myself will go before thee, and give thee rest.

Thus saith the Lord, Stand ye in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths of the Lord; and see what is the good way, and walk in it, and ye shall find purification for your souls. But they said, We will not walk [in them].

days.t: When you turn and mourn, you shall be saved
x: Thus saith the Lord, the Holy Lord of Israel; When thou shalt turn and mourn, then thou shalt be saved; and thou shalt know where thou wast, when thou didst trust in vanities: [then] your strength became vain, yet ye would not hearken:

days.t: Let us fear lest any seem to have failed to reach it
x: Therefore we should fear, lest ever, the promise to enter into His rest left remaining, any of you⁺ should seem to have fallen short.
